methodNotes: Reduced transparency was emulated through CDP Emulation.setEmulatedMedia, because Playwright has no reducedTransparency option, and confirmed with matchMedia.
Missing backdrop-filter support was simulated by stripping @supports blocks from four Vite-served CSS modules: preview.css, ui/card.css, ui/tabs.css and ui/tooltip.css.

The axe color-contrast rule is disabled only under forced-colors emulation, where axe reads author colours (the flat family fails the same way); measured forced-colour contrast on the solid section replaces it.
The ghost Button was checked on an injected clone, because the scenario has no ghost Button.
